nodes.label: PARrad MD-GRU Stage 3 Smoke Configuration
nodes.schedule: one physical, one semantic, and one verify epoch
nodes.rationale: The Stage 3 plan defines this as the bounded CUDA smoke path: it uses the production architecture and accepted checkpoints but limits each phase to one epoch and writes to a separate output directory.

nodes.label: PARrad MD-GRU Stage 3 Formal Configuration
nodes.rationale: This is the production Stage 3 variant. Its longer phase schedules and conservative five-epoch early-stopping patience contrast with the one-epoch smoke configuration while preserving the same transition constants.

nodes.label: PARrad RadMamba Stage 1 Smoothness-2 Pilot
nodes.rationale: This pilot isolates a moderate temporal-smoothness setting by raising both label-run and streaming weights to 2.0 relative to the RadMamba pilot baseline.

nodes.label: PARrad RadMamba Stage 1 Smoothness-5 Pilot
nodes.rationale: This pilot isolates a stronger temporal-smoothness setting by setting both label-run and streaming weights to 5.0 relative to the RadMamba pilot baseline.

nodes.label: PARrad RadMamba Stage 1 Pilot Configuration
nodes.rationale: This short no-streaming configuration is the RadMamba pilot baseline against which the smoothness-2 and smoothness-5 variants can be compared.

nodes.label: PARrad RadMamba Stage 1 Formal Configuration
nodes.rationale: The formal RadMamba variant retains the moderate smoothness setting and expands the pilot to both the full label-run schedule and a recording-continuous streaming phase.

nodes.label: PARrad Stage 1 TCN Pilot Configuration
nodes.rationale: The 3+1 pilot was run before the full PARrad Stage 1 experiment to test whether label-run pretraining followed by streaming fine-tuning and GPU resources were viable.

nodes.label: PARrad Stage 1 TCN Formal Configuration
nodes.status: production run launched; no completion recorded in the listed ledger
nodes.plan_reconciliation: The implementation plan initially specified training batch size 16, whereas the present run-specific configuration and progress ledger use batch size 8 for the low-GPU production launch.
nodes.rationale: The formal configuration follows the two-phase label-run and streaming protocol, with a reduced batch size matching the recorded remote low-memory launch.

nodes.label: PARrad Tiny Stage 1 Configuration
nodes.rationale: This tiny configuration validates the reduced PARrad RD/MD encoder and temporary closed-set Stage 1 head on deterministic synthetic data without requiring a GPU.

nodes.label: PARrad Tiny Stage 2 Configuration
nodes.rationale: This tiny configuration validates the PARrad Event Former alignment path and class-template losses while loading the tiny Stage 1 export and using a tiny local language-model backend.

nodes.label: Generic Stage 1 Velocity-Pretraining Configuration
nodes.rationale: This preserved production configuration trains the original radar path with velocity-weighted pretraining and is explicitly excluded from the PARrad foundation plan's modifications.

nodes.label: Generic Stage 2 Qwen Alignment Configuration
nodes.rationale: This generic Stage 2 configuration preserves the original Radar Encoder checkpoint lineage while using the local Qwen model and explicit alignment, consistency, and streaming-checkpoint settings.

nodes.label: Generic Tiny Stage 1 Configuration
nodes.rationale: This tiny baseline provides a CPU-only synthetic Stage 1 smoke path and defines the reusable tiny model dimensions for the generic two-stage test.

nodes.label: Generic Tiny Stage 2 Configuration
nodes.rationale: This tiny baseline validates the generic Event Former and Stage 2 alignment path using the tiny Stage 1 export and a tiny language-model backend.

nodes.label: PARrad Front-End Foundation Implementation Plan
nodes.scope: P0/P1/P2 front-end foundations, with P3 deferred
nodes.rationale: The plan preserves the original RD plus Point Cloud path while adding a separate PARrad RD/MD streaming front end that satisfies the existing four-token Event Former contract.

nodes.label: Remote Training Bootstrap Implementation Plan
nodes.status: planned; resulting Stage 2 local-model path is present
nodes.rationale: The plan makes the remote checkout reproducible and CUDA-capable while strictly separating environment, model weights, generated data, and real production artifacts.

nodes.label: PARrad Label-Run Streaming SDD Progress Ledger
implemented_findings: label-run enumeration, stateful TBPTT, recording-continuous training, phase schedules, checkpointing, and diagnostics were completed
the validation/test diagnostic construction was corrected so authoritative boundary masking is applied only during evaluation
GPU cooling, not utilization alone, constrained throughput in the recorded 3+1 pilot
deferred_issues: Gemma adapter tests remain explicitly out of scope
streaming log aggregation uses valid-frame-count weighting rather than the exact class-weight denominator
one unrelated torch CPU autocast deprecation warning remains
nodes.rationale: This ledger is the strongest listed evidence that the label-run/streaming plan moved from planned tasks to tested implementation and a launched formal experiment.

nodes.label: PARrad Label-Run and Streaming Training Implementation Plan
nodes.status: completed according to the adjacent progress ledger
nodes.rationale: The plan replaces fixed label-agnostic training windows with trimmed label runs followed by state-carrying TBPTT, while forcing continuous validation and test to remain independent of label-selected boundaries.

nodes.label: Stage 2 Event Former Bootstrap Repair Implementation Plan
nodes.status: implemented; all listed checklist items are checked
nodes.rationale: The repair plan explicitly sequences representation bootstrap before language supervision so the accepted Stage 1 Radar Tokens can train non-collapsed Event Tokens without destabilizing the completed encoder.

nodes.label: PARrad Stage P3 Continuous Transition Implementation Plan
nodes.status: planned; all checklist items are unchecked, although both requested Stage 3 configuration files are present
nodes.rationale: The plan keeps the accepted Stage P2 checkpoint frozen and trains only four small heads in explicit physical, semantic, and verify phases before allowing a closed-loop controller or production evaluation.

nodes.label: PARrad Continuous Semantic Event Formation Adaptation Design
nodes.rationale: The design treats PARrad as a validation variant, not a replacement for the full RD plus Point Cloud system, and separates RD semantic evidence from MD motion prior and physical proposal evidence.

nodes.label: PARrad Label-Run and Streaming Training Specification
nodes.rationale: The specification protects inference realism by requiring ignored transition frames to evolve stream state, excluding them only from loss, and forbidding labels from selecting validation or test chunk boundaries.

nodes.label: PARrad Stage P3 Continuous Transition Design
nodes.rationale: The design separates physical proposal from semantic confirmation, freezes the accepted Stage P2 representation, and withholds hierarchical memory until all Stage P3 correctness, latency, and transition-quality gates pass.

nodes.label: PARrad RD-Semantic and MD-Prior Front End
nodes.rationale: RD supplies the semantic representation, while MD is a derived motion prior that modulates RD and supplies physical-change features rather than acting as an independent semantic modality or Point Cloud substitute.

nodes.label: Canonical PARrad Data Contract
nodes.rationale: A separate immutable contract validates RD, MD, labels, and timestamps before modeling, preserves continuous-session metadata, and fails closed on shape, finiteness, timestamp, or split leakage errors.

nodes.label: PARrad Radar Encoder
nodes.status: specified; this plan alone does not prove checklist completion
nodes.rationale: The encoder preserves Doppler structure through asymmetric convolution, adds causal temporal context, and exposes exactly four learned Radar Tokens per 180 ms update so the existing Event Former interface remains unchanged.

nodes.label: Identity-Initialized Motion FiLM
nodes.rationale: Zero-initialized gamma and beta projections make FiLM an exact identity at initialization, allowing stable MD-guided training and a controlled RD-only versus MD-guided ablation without initially corrupting the RD representation.

nodes.label: Four-Query Radar Token Contract
nodes.rationale: Exactly four learned attention queries pool time-Doppler detail into the fixed [B,4,256] Event Former contract, avoiding a higher token count that would change cross-attention and latency interfaces.

nodes.label: Streaming and Commit Event Former Interface
nodes.status: preserved and later adapted by Stage 2 bootstrap work
nodes.rationale: Keeping stream_update and commit_refine contracts stable lets PARrad validate continuous Event Token formation without replacing the original Event Former or coupling physical motion state directly to semantic confirm.

nodes.label: PARrad Stage P0 Data Audit Gate
nodes.rationale: Model training stops if RD, MD, labels, and timestamps cannot be aligned reliably; truncating to the shortest stream would hide corrupt inputs rather than surface them.

nodes.label: PARrad Stage P1 Closed-Set Pretraining
nodes.rationale: A temporary frame-level weighted classifier teaches the front end activity-relevant RD/MD features without claiming pose-guided, open-set, or category-agnostic capability; the temporary head is excluded from deployment export.

nodes.label: PARrad Stage P2 Class-Template Semantic Alignment
nodes.rationale: Three deterministic fixed templates per action reduce dependence on a single label string while remaining explicitly closed-set and unsuitable for free-form caption or open-vocabulary claims.

nodes.label: PARrad Causal-TCN Stage 1 Encoder
nodes.status: configured by PARrad Stage 1 YAML variants
nodes.rationale: Separate RD and MD causal TCNs provide chunked/full-sequence temporal equivalence and a single streaming state for online updates.

nodes.label: Causal RadMamba Stage 1 Encoder Variant
nodes.status: present in pilot and formal configurations
nodes.rationale: The RadMamba files define a controlled Stage 1 encoder alternative on the same PARrad manifests, windowing, and label-run/streaming protocol, allowing encoder and smoothing choices to be compared without changing the data split.

nodes.label: PARrad Label-Run Then Streaming TBPTT Flow
nodes.rationale: Boundary-trimmed label runs first provide clean frame-level supervision; continuous state-carrying TBPTT then corrects temporal behavior while maintaining inference-consistent state evolution.

nodes.label: Label-Run Pretraining Phase
nodes.rationale: Contiguous one-label runs remove transition ambiguity, exclude ignored gaps, drop too-short runs, and split long runs without mixing classes.

nodes.label: Recording-Continuous Streaming TBPTT Phase
nodes.rationale: Ordered recording sequences carry both TCN caches and update index across chunks, detach only at TBPTT boundaries, and reset state only between recordings.

nodes.label: Label-Independent Continuous Recording Evaluator
nodes.rationale: Validation and test use complete recording order and fixed frame-count chunking, with labels reserved for loss and metrics so label-selected windows cannot leak into evaluation.

nodes.label: PARrad Subject- and Session-Disjoint Split
nodes.status: specified and configured for production PARrad runs
nodes.scope: train subjects 02/03/04, validation subject 05, test subject 06
nodes.rationale: Splitting by subject before session and sensor expansion prevents subject, session, and dual-sensor-view leakage; continuous sessions remain intact within each split.

nodes.label: PARrad Temporal Smoothness Penalty
nodes.status: present as baseline, smooth2, and smooth5 experiment variants
nodes.rationale: Explicitly changing label-run and streaming smoothness weights creates a controlled pilot ablation over temporal prediction stability rather than conflating it with architecture changes.

nodes.label: Causal MD-GRU Stage 1 Encoder
nodes.status: configured and accepted as the frozen Stage 3 front end
nodes.rationale: Stage 3 configs identify causal_md_gru as the encoder; Stage 2 and Stage 3 plans require this accepted encoder to remain frozen while only downstream transition heads train.

nodes.label: Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct Backbone
nodes.status: configured through a local offline model path
nodes.rationale: The local Qwen checkpoint avoids network dependence; during Stage 2 warmup it is frozen, and during joint training only its LoRA parameters are enabled while the Radar Encoder remains frozen.

nodes.label: Stage 1 Causal MD-GRU Token-Warmup Checkpoint
nodes.rationale: This is the action-dependent Radar Encoder export required by the Stage 2 bootstrap repair and the frozen encoder used when reconstructing Stage 3.

nodes.label: Stage 2 Event Joint Formal V1 Checkpoint
nodes.rationale: Stage 3 may train only its own heads, so the accepted Stage 2 checkpoint is referenced by hash and never overwritten or weakened.

nodes.label: Small-Scale Stable Radar Injection
nodes.rationale: A small but nonzero tanh-parameterized cross-attention residual opens finite gradients to Radar Tokens on the first backward pass without letting unstable radar injection dominate the pretrained LLM prefix.

nodes.label: Convex Event-State Update Gate
nodes.rationale: Sigmoid gates constrained to [0,1] and convex interpolation remove the negative and greater-than-one extrapolation that previously caused explosive streaming state norms.

nodes.label: Truthful AMP Optimizer-Step Accounting
nodes.rationale: A GradScaler scale decrease reveals a skipped update, so the global step count and max-step gate advance only after an optimizer update actually occurs.

nodes.label: Duplicate-Label-Safe Supervised Alignment
nodes.rationale: Same-label samples are treated as additional positives in both alignment directions, avoiding false negatives in small 14-class contrastive batches.

nodes.label: Stage 2 Action-Supervised Semantic Warmup
nodes.status: implemented; planned production duration is 3 epochs
nodes.rationale: Before adding caption loss, action classification and stream/commit consistency force Event Tokens to become action-separable and prevent a collapsed representation or shortcut through the shared language prefix.

nodes.label: Stage 2 Restrained Joint Semantic Phase
nodes.status: implemented in plan; artifact referenced as formal v1
nodes.caption_weight: ramped from 0.0 to 0.1 over two epochs
nodes.rationale: Joint training retains auxiliary action supervision and gently ramps caption loss so the large language-model objective cannot recreate the pretrained-prefix shortcut before Event Tokens are trustworthy.

nodes.label: Stage 2 Representation and Conditioning Stop Gates
nodes.status: implemented in plan and required before later stages
nodes.warmup_gate: validation auxiliary Macro-F1 > 0.20, stream/commit effective rank > 2.0, mean off-diagonal cosine < 0.98
nodes.joint_gate: positive alignment margin, retrieval above chance, and real-versus-shuffled caption loss gap of at least 0.02
nodes.rationale: Hard representation and counterfactual gates prevent formal Stage 2, and therefore Stage 3 lineage, from inheriting collapsed Event Tokens or an unconditioned language model.

nodes.label: Proposal-Candidate-Semantic-Verify Transition Pipeline
nodes.status: pending-review design and unchecked implementation plan; config artifacts present
nodes.rationale: Physical radar change only proposes a Candidate; semantic difference, stability, and maturity alone decide Confirm, preserving a strict separation between change detection and semantic confirmation.

nodes.label: Continuous Transition Target and Split Audit
nodes.rationale: Ignored gaps break event adjacency, recording edges are not boundaries, and missing direct transitions or class runs block training rather than being silently patched.

nodes.label: Fingerprinted Frozen Stage 3 Feature Cache
nodes.rationale: Fail-closed fingerprints prevent cached Radar Tokens and oracle keys from a different checkpoint, configuration, or split manifest from being reused silently.

nodes.label: Stage 3 Four Learned Transition Heads
nodes.rationale: Only four small heads are trainable over the frozen Stage P2 module; physical heads establish high-recall proposals, while the semantic and monotonic heads impose confirmation discipline.

nodes.label: Parameter-Free Candidate Stability
nodes.rationale: Stability is derived from the last three Candidate keys and is zero before three updates; it has no independent parameters or loss, avoiding a fifth learned head.

nodes.label: Stage 3 Physical Proposal Phase
nodes.status: planned; smoke and formal schedules configured
nodes.rationale: Weighted BCE on time-based Gaussian targets trains a high-recall physical proposal first, with event-local prototypes reset at supervised boundaries during training.

nodes.label: Stage 3 Semantic Difference Phase
nodes.status: planned; smoke and formal schedules configured
nodes.rationale: Balanced mature/nascent same-class and different-class pairs train semantic discrimination without permitting split crossing or duplicating validation and test samples.

nodes.label: Stage 3 Verify Calibration Phase
nodes.status: planned; smoke and formal schedules configured
nodes.rationale: True, shifted, within-event, and short-spike trajectories train Verify while weighted false confirms impose the over-segmentation cost without adding another loss term.

nodes.label: Stage 3 Three-Phase Head Runner
nodes.checkpoint_policy: separate best and last checkpoint per phase with fingerprint-bound resume
nodes.rationale: Sequential phase training and validation-specific metric selection prevent Verify calibration from starting before physical proposals and semantic differences are viable.

nodes.label: PARrad Fork-and-Shadow Controller
nodes.rationale: Proposal freezes the Active reference while Candidate and Shadow consume identical post-proposal updates; Reject adopts Shadow in O(1) without radar replay and Confirm promotes Candidate with explicit event-buffer ownership.

nodes.label: Validation-Only Stage 3 Threshold Calibration
nodes.rationale: A fixed validation grid is optimized for boundary quality subject to the 1.2 s median confirmation latency, then frozen by fingerprint before a single immutable test execution.

nodes.label: Stage 3 Latency and Correctness Go-No-Go
nodes.rationale: Stage 3 passes only with improved boundary quality, bounded confirmation latency, semantic signal above baseline, no-replay Reject equivalence, finite stable state, and P95 latency under the hard 180 ms deadline.

nodes.label: Generic Velocity-Guided Stage 1 Pretraining
nodes.rationale: The original production Stage 1 path uses a velocity-weighted objective; PARrad validation deliberately avoids claiming equivalence because PARrad has no point cloud or framewise 3D skeleton.

nodes.label: Generic Radar-Language Stage 2 Alignment
nodes.rationale: The generic Stage 2 path consumes the Stage 1 encoder export and combines text, semantic alignment, and stream/commit consistency with a local Qwen backbone.

nodes.label: Isolated SEER CUDA Runtime
nodes.rationale: The project-local symlink exposes an isolated environment whose packages and cache live on the large data disk, while model weights and generated outputs remain outside Git.

nodes.label: SEER Proposal Book v2.3
nodes.rationale: The adaptation and Stage P3 designs derive the PARrad validation architecture and transition state machine from specified sections of this internal proposal.
